description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents... “HP 36W Condo,” at High Pointe Resort in Seacrest Beach. Immerse yourself in coastal bliss with wraparound balconies showcasing endless views of sugar-white sands and emerald waters. This 3-suite haven is designed for ultimate relaxation, blending modern comfort with beachside serenity. With resort perks like a community pool, tiki bar, and private beach access, this unit is your ticket to unforgettable moments along the 30A shoreline. Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Gulf-Front 3rd-Floor Corner Unit with Panoramic Views – Wake up to breathtaking ocean vistas and feel the serenity of endless blue skies.Spacious Wrap-Around Balconies Perfect for Sunsets – Unwind as the day melts into vibrant hues, creating the ultimate setting for relaxation or a romantic evening.Large Resort-Like Pool, Hot Tub, and Outdoor Grill Area – Dive into pure bliss, soak away stress, and enjoy lively gatherings with friends and family.Tiki Bar and On-Site Dining At Crabby Steve’s – Savor tropical vibes with refreshing drinks and delicious coastal flavors right at your doorstep.Luxurious Bedrooms and En-Suite Bathrooms – Indulge in comfort and style with elegantly designed spaces crafted for a restful retreat.Private Beach Boardwalk Steps Away – Feel the soft sand under your feet and let the gentle waves be your daily escape.Proximity to Popular Attractions Like Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach – Immerse yourself in the charm of nearby towns, offering boutique shopping, fine dining, and a vibrant coastal culture.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐“Absolutely wonderful unit with breathtaking views of the beach and water. Couldn’t recommend it more!” – William⭐“Perfect location with tons of space for our family! The views were unbeatable, and being so close to shops and restaurants made our stay incredibly convenient!” – Brandon⭐“The balcony was our favorite spot—listening to the ocean was so relaxing. Plus, the easy access to shops and restaurants made everything hassle-free!” – Amy*** LIVING AREA ***Gather, unwind, and soak in incredible gulf views from the open-concept living area. Styled with a cozy sectional, armchairs, and a large-screen TV, this welcoming space is perfect for lounging after a day at the beach. Enjoy direct balcony access for sunset views or late-night stargazing.Luxurious, plush sectional and cozy armchairs for ultimate comfortStunning large flat-screen TV, perfect for movie nights or binge-watching your favorite showsStep onto the balcony to enjoy breathtaking Gulf views, complete with a dining table for 4 to savor meals al fresco*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The newly renovated kitchen is a chef's dream, boasting gleaming stainless steel appliances, a stunning sea glass backsplash, and generous counter space that makes meal preparation a breeze. Gather around the elegant dining table with seating for six to share memorable meals, or start your day with a quick breakfast at the stylish bar.Fully equipped kitchen featuring sleek, modern stainless-steel appliances for all your culinary needsStylish breakfast bar with seating for 3—perfect for casual dining, quick snacks, or morning coffeeSpacious dining table for 6, offering a stunning ocean-view backdrop for unforgettable mealsConvenient washer and dryer available just off the kitchen for easy laundry access*** BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMSPrimary King Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, gulf-front balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower.Queen Guest Suite: 2 Queen Beds, flat-screen TV, gulf-front balcony access and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo.King Guest Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower*** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***Experience the ultimate getaway at High Pointe Resort, where every moment is designed to impress. Unwind by the stunning community pool, surrounded by vibrant tropical landscaping that feels like paradise. Savor mouthwatering oceanfront dining at the renowned Crabby Steve’s, where incredible views meet delicious cuisine. Families will love the kid-friendly amenities, including a fun playground and shuffleboard courts, perfect for creating unforgettable memories.Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest Beach.Expansive Pool Deck Featuring a large Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot TubBeach Front Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean ViewsExclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and PrivacyAmenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach EnthusiastsWell-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports LoversChildren's Playground for the Little OnesShuffleboard Court for Family FunBBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining*** LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ***High Pointe Resort is perfectly situated along Scenic Highway 30A, offering seamless access to nearby attractions and local flavor. Stroll to Rosemary Beach for chic boutiques and top-notch dining, or explore the unique architecture of Alys Beach.Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibe.Alys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphere.Carillon Downtown & Market Street (8-minute drive) – a vibrant hub for shopping and dining.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Bicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE ***TDT #: 210068
